# Getting help with Volpi

| You want to | Go to |
|---|---|
| Learn what Volpi does | The documentation on the Volpi website (`/docs/`) |
| Ask a question or suggest a feature | [Volpi on Discord](https://discord.gg/gkHMSq6emT) |
| Report a bug in Volpi | The [Bug in Volpi](https://github.com/Phantom-Con-Artist/Volpi-Documentations/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) form. Read [how to report a bug](../README.md#report-a-bug) first. |
| Report a mistake in the documentation | The [Documentation or website problem](https://github.com/Phantom-Con-Artist/Volpi-Documentations/issues/new?template=docs_issue.yml) form |
| Report a security problem | Privately, as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) |

Volpi is not open source, so this repository has no app code. It holds the documentation, bug reports and the website.
